# Obsessive Cupcake Disorder (OCD)

> Bespoke celebration cakes, wedding cakes, cupcakes and signature confections, made to order in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Home bakery, order-only (no walk-in storefront) — orders taken via WhatsApp or the website's order form, any time.

OCD (Obsessive Cupcake Disorder) is a South African home bakery run by Darrel Rhyce and Melissa Chetty. Every cake is bespoke, designed around the occasion rather than chosen from a catalogue, and finished in white chocolate ganache rather than fondant.

## How ordering works

There is no online checkout or fixed pricing — every order is an enquiry. A customer fills in one of two online order forms (standard cake/cupcake, or wedding cake), and OCD reviews it and responds with a quote and next steps, usually within 24 hours. Standard orders need at least 14 days' notice; wedding orders benefit from more. Delivery is offered throughout KwaZulu-Natal, or customers can collect.

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Location: Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Delivery area: KwaZulu-Natal.
- Dietary options: gluten-free and eggless cakes are available (eggless only in the Vanilla Bean flavour); OCD cannot guarantee an entirely allergen-free environment.
- Payment: full payment is required to confirm an order; 50% of that is a non-refundable deposit. No cash refunds — cancellations are credited as an OCD Credit Voucher.
- Google rating: 4.9 stars from real customer reviews (see the Google Business Profile linked from the site's contact/reviews sections).
